commands.description.back: Return to your saved back location.
commands.description.balance: View your balance or another player balance.
commands.description.banip: Ban a numeric IP address or a player last address.
commands.description.bottom: Move to the lowest safe location in the current column.
commands.description.broadcast: Broadcast a message to all online players.
commands.description.broadcastworld: Broadcast a message in one loaded world.
commands.description.burn: Set an online player fire duration.
commands.description.cellulosesz: Show CellulosesZ information and runtime controls.
commands.description.depth: Show your depth relative to sea level.
commands.description.ext: Extinguish yourself or an online player.
commands.description.help: Browse commands available to this source.
commands.description.helpop: Send a help request to online staff.
commands.description.ice: Freeze yourself or an online player.
commands.description.jailedplayers: List active and pending jailed players.
commands.description.jump: Move to the safe location you are targeting.
commands.description.kill: Kill an online player through the platform operation.
commands.description.mail: Read, delete, or send persistent mail.
commands.description.me: Broadcast an action using your display name.
commands.description.mute: Mute, time-mute, or unmute a known player.
commands.description.ping: Reply with Pong or echo literal text.
commands.description.realname: Find online real names by nickname.
commands.description.reply: Reply to your last private-message target.
commands.description.seen: Show whether and when a player was seen.
commands.description.setjail: Create or replace a jail at your location.
commands.description.setworth: Set or remove an item worth.
commands.description.socialspy: Toggle or set private-message social spy.
commands.description.sudo: Dispatch one command as an online player.
commands.description.tempbanip: Temporarily ban a numeric IP or player address.
commands.description.top: Move to the highest safe location in the current column.
commands.description.tp: Teleport yourself or another online player.
commands.description.tpa: Request to teleport to an online player.
commands.description.tpaall: Send teleport-here requests to eligible online players.
commands.description.tpahere: Request an online player to teleport to you.
commands.description.tpall: Teleport eligible online players to a destination player.
commands.description.tphere: Teleport an online player to you.
commands.description.tpo: Override teleport preference for an online move.
commands.description.tpoffline: Teleport to a known player stored logout location.
commands.description.tpohere: Override preference and teleport an online player to you.
commands.description.tppos: Teleport to typed coordinates in a loaded world.
commands.description.tpr: Teleport to a bounded random safe location.
commands.description.unban: Pardon a permanently or temporarily banned player.
